sourceAssessment.audiences: KOV internal role/industry audience crosswalk extracted from indexable role pages; one record per unique mapped route.
sourceAssessment.jobFunctions: Exactly 100 KOV-defined functional records: 19 parent function groups and 81 distinct responsibility subfunctions. Every record is mapped to an indexable KOV role page or the procurement FAQ; these are internal functional classifications, not O*NET occupations or SOC job families.
sourceAssessment.seniorityLevels: KOV internal title-scope descriptors. These are not a universal seniority scale and contain no years-of-experience thresholds.
sourceAssessment.employmentTypes: A 30-record cross-dimensional collection: 10 ICSE-18 status categories and 20 externally documented work arrangements/modalities. These records overlap and are not a mutually-exclusive classification.
sourceAssessment.careerChallenges: KOV FAQ-derived planning and career-positioning topics. These describe authored content, not measured prevalence.
sourceAssessment.careerSearchIntents: Primary and secondary keyword candidates from the KOV keyword map and research records, exact KOV FAQ questions, and relevant Google Search Console query rows. Editorial/researched candidates remain explicitly marked as hypotheses; the 2026-11-20 source export retains actual query clicks, impressions, CTR and average position for observed queries. No Search Console metric is described as search volume.
sourceAssessment.googleSearchConsole: A connected KOV Career Agency property export covering 2025-07-20 to 2026-11-17 is retained in data/taxonomy/gsc-observed-search-queries.json. Relevant queries retain actual clicks, impressions, CTR and average position; impressions are not described as search volume. Google API documentation: https://developers.google.com/webmaster-tools/v1/searchanalytics/query

employment-type.description: Work performed when called as needed; hours may vary with workload. This classification is not mutually exclusive with records in other dimensions; legal meanings vary by jurisdiction.

employment-type.name: Zero-hours contract
employment-type.description: A contract without a fixed amount of working hours, as described in EU working-conditions guidance. This classification is not mutually exclusive with records in other dimensions; legal meanings vary by jurisdiction.

employment-type.name: Job sharing
employment-type.description: Two people voluntarily share responsibility for one full-time job. This classification is not mutually exclusive with records in other dimensions; legal meanings vary by jurisdiction.

employment-type.name: Multi-party employment relationship
employment-type.description: Work arranged through more than two contractual parties or an intermediary. This classification is not mutually exclusive with records in other dimensions; legal meanings vary by jurisdiction.

employment-type.name: Subcontracted work
employment-type.description: Work delivered through a subcontracting relationship; the legal status depends on the actual relationship. This classification is not mutually exclusive with records in other dimensions; legal meanings vary by jurisdiction.

employment-type.name: Dependent self-employment
employment-type.description: An ILO-described relationship where a formally self-employed worker is economically dependent. This classification is not mutually exclusive with records in other dimensions; legal meanings vary by jurisdiction.

employment-type.name: Disguised employment relationship
employment-type.description: A work relationship whose presentation obscures the underlying employment relationship. This classification is not mutually exclusive with records in other dimensions; legal meanings vary by jurisdiction.

employment-type.name: Freelance work
employment-type.description: A common label that does not itself determine legal status; classification depends on the actual relationship. This classification is not mutually exclusive with records in other dimensions; legal meanings vary by jurisdiction.

employment-type.name: Agency worker
employment-type.description: A worker contracted through an agency to work temporarily for a hirer. This classification is not mutually exclusive with records in other dimensions; legal meanings vary by jurisdiction.

employment-type.name: Telework
employment-type.description: Work outside the employer premises using information and communications technology. This classification is not mutually exclusive with records in other dimensions; legal meanings vary by jurisdiction.

employment-type.name: Home-based work
employment-type.description: Work performed at home or another chosen premise other than the employer workplace, as defined in ILO materials. This classification is not mutually exclusive with records in other dimensions; legal meanings vary by jurisdiction.

employment-type.name: Digital platform work
employment-type.description: Work organized or facilitated through a digital labour platform; status is determined separately. This classification is not mutually exclusive with records in other dimensions; legal meanings vary by jurisdiction.
